usage: 炒芥蘭 is commonly used as a noun to refer to the dish itself in menus or conversations.
You can use 炒芥蘭 as a subject: '炒芥蘭好好味' means 'Stir-fried gai lan is delicious.'
It can also be an object, as in '我想叫一份炒芥蘭' meaning 'I want to order a serving of stir-fried gai lan.'
炒芥蘭 can be combined with verbs related to food, like 炒 (stir-fry) or 食 (eat).
When talking about preferences, you can say '我唔食炒芥蘭' meaning 'I don't eat stir-fried gai lan.'
